Ili kubadilisha nafasi yako ya ndege (rebook), unaweza kufuata hatua hizi:

1. Tembelea tovuti ya Kenya Airways (https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/), kisha chagua “Manage Booking”.
2. Utaona kiunganishi cha kubadilisha nafasi (rebooking link) juu kilichowekwa “Click here”.
3. Ingiza namba yako ya marejeleo ya uhifadhi (booking reference) au namba ya e-ticket na jina lako la mwisho.
4. Chagua safari mbadala inayokufaa.
5. Thibitisha safari yako mpya, bila malipo ya ziada.

**Mambo muhimu ya kuzingatia:**
* **Masharti:** Unaweza kubadilisha nafasi mwenyewe tu ikiwa safari yako imepata mabadiliko ya ratiba (kama vile kucheleweshwa au kufutwa). Huwezi kubadilisha nafasi kwa safari ambayo haijapatwa na usumbufu.
* **Chaguzi za safari:** Safari zinazopatikana kwa ajili ya kubadilisha nafasi ni zile ambazo muda wake ni chini ya saa 24 kutoka safari yako ya awali au siku 7 baada ya safari yako ya awali.
* **Malipo:** Huduma hii ya kubadilisha nafasi mwenyewe ni bure kwa safari zilizovurugika.
* **Mabadiliko ya safari ya kurudi (Inbound):** Ikiwa safari yako ya kwenda (outbound) imebadilishwa, huwezi kubadilisha safari ya kurudi (inbound) bure kupitia chombo hiki. Ili kubadilisha safari ya kurudi kwa sababu umepoteza siku(ma) kwenye safari ya kwenda, itabidi uwasiliane na wakala wako wa safari au kituo chetu cha mawasiliano (Contact center).

Ikiwa unahitaji msaada zaidi, unaweza kutembelea ukurasa wetu wa Huduma kwa Wateja (Customer Support) au kupiga simu kwa +254 711 024 747.

Ili kubadilisha nafasi yako ya ndege (rebook), unapaswa kufanya yafuatayo:

1. Tembelea tovuti ya Kenya Airways (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ).
2. Chagua “Manage Booking”.
3. Bonyeza kiungo cha rebooking kilicho juu kilichowekwa “Click here”.
4. Ingiza namba yako ya booking (booking reference) na jina lako la mwisho.
5. Chagua safari mbadala inayofaa ratiba yako.
6. Thibitisha safari yako mpya bila malipo ya ziada.

**Muhimu:**
* Utahitaji namba yako ya booking au namba ya tiketi ya kielektroniki (e-ticket number).
* Huduma hii ya kujibadilishia nafasi (self-rebooking) inapatikana tu kwa safari ambazo zimeathiriwa na mabadiliko ya ratiba, yaani zimechelewa au ghalaulishwa. Huwezi kubadilisha safari ambayo haijavurugika.
* Safari zinazoweza kubadilishwa ni zile ambazo ratiba yake ni chini ya saa 24 kutoka safari yako ya awali au siku 7 baada ya hapo.

**Jinsi ya kubadilisha nafasi yako ya ndege (kwa kutumia huduma ya Self‑Rebooking ya Kenya Airways)**  

1. **Jipatie taarifa ya usafiri**  
   - Hakikisha unayo **nambari ya uhakiki (booking reference) au nambari ya tiketi ya kielektroniki (e‑ticket)**. Hii ndilo kila unachohitaji ili kuanza mchakato. 【S1】

2. **Tembelea tovuti ya Kenya Airways**  
   - Nenda kwenye **https://www.kenya‑airways.com/en‑ke/**. 【S1】  
   - Chagua **“Manage Booking”** (Usimamizi wa Uhakiki). 【S1】

3. **Fungua kiungo cha ku‑rebook**  
   - Juu ya ukurasa, ubadilikie kiungo kilichoandikwa **“Click here”** ambacho unaelekeza kwenye chaguo la **Self‑Rebooking**. 【S1】

4. **Weka namba yako ya uhakiki**  
   - Ingiza **nambari ya uhakiki** pamoja na **jina la mwisho** (last name). 【S1】

5. **Chagua chaguo la ndege**  
   - Ukishogea, utaona **orodha ya ndege na nyakati zilizopo** ambazo zinaweza kutumika.  
   - Ni **nchini saa 24 zilizopita** au **siku 7 baada ya safari yako ya awali**. 【S1】

6. **Thibitisha mabadiliko**  
   - Chagua ndege unayotaka, kisha **thibitisha** bila ada ya ziada. 【S1】

7. **Pokea tiketi mpya**  
   - Baada ya kukamilisha, **utapokea barua pepe yenye tiketi ya kielektroniki na pasipoti ya ndege (boarding pass)**. 【S1】

---

### Mambo Muhimu ya Kuzijua

- **Huduma hii inapatikana tu kwa safari zilizobadilishwa (imecheleweshwa au kughairiwa).** Ikiwa safari yako haijaharibika, hutaweza ku‑rebook kupitia chombo hiki; itabidi upigie simu kituo cha huduma kwa wateja. 【S1】

- **Kama hukamilisha mchakato wa ku‑rebook**, mfumo uta‑rebook otomatiki kwenye ndege inayopatikana zaidi, na utapokea barua pepe yenye taarifa mpya. 【S1】

- **Hakuna malipo ya ziada** kwa matumizi ya chombo cha Self‑Rebooking. 【S1】

- **Mabegi yako yatasambazwa otomatiki** hadi kwenye ndege mpya ikiwa tayari umesajili (checked‑in). 【S1】

- **Kama unahitaji kubadilisha safari ya kurudi (inbound) au unahitaji mabadiliko zaidi ya moja kwa kila usumbufu**, tafadhali wasiliana na wakala wako wa safari au **Kituo cha Mawasiliano (Contact Centre)**. 【S1】

---

### Unahitaji Msaada wa Ziada?  

- **Simu:** +254 711 024 747  
- **Tovuti ya msaada:** Tembelea **Sehemu ya Customer Support** kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

"ITINERARY/RECEIPT" means a document or documents issued by us or on our behalf to Passengers travelling on Electronic Tickets that contains the Passenger's name, flight information and notices.

"PASSENGER" means any person, except members of the crew, carried or to be carried in an aircraft pursuant to a Ticket. (See also definition for "you", "your" and "yourself").

"PASSENGER COUPON" or "PASSENGER RECEIPT" means that portion of the Ticket issued by us or on our behalf, which is so marked and which ultimately is to be retained by you.

"SPECIAL DRAWING RIGHTS" are an international unit of account, defined by the International Monetary Fund, based upon the values of several leading currencies. The currency values of the Special Drawing Right fluctuate and are re-calculated each banking day. These values are known to most commercial bankers and are reported regularly in leading financial journals.

"STOPOVER" means a scheduled stop on your journey, at a point between the place of departure and the place of destination.

"TARIFF" means the published fares, charges and/or related conditions of carriage of an airline filed, where required, with the appropriate authorities.
